intro: For NGOs, schools, humanitarian teams, universities, faith communities, and professional bodies. Every session is practical, interactive, and adapted to your audience.
topics_title: What I speak and train on

topics.title: Trauma-informed care
topics.text: How trauma shapes the brain, body and behaviour, and how churches, schools and organisations can respond with safety and dignity.

topics.title: Understanding children through play
topics.text: Why play is a child's language, and how parents, teachers and carers can use it to connect and heal.

topics.title: Healing in conflict-affected communities
topics.text: Community-based trauma healing for displaced families and the leaders who serve them.

topics.title: Faith and mental health
topics.text: Honest conversations for pastors and congregations about emotional pain, stigma and seeking help.

topics.title: Parenting for emotional health
topics.text: Raising emotionally strong children and strengthening the parent–child bond.

topics.title: Caring for the carers
topics.text: Recognising burnout and secondary trauma in helpers, and building sustainable self-care.
